'''Fensi Moisk''' was a [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who was active in the twilight [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Guide" /> He served as a crew member of the ''[[Kintan Comet]]''.<ref name="Guide" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his accomplice [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] came to see the local<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]]<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Fensi Moisk was conversing with the<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Ualaq/Legends|Ualaq]]<ref name="Guide" /> [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Ix Bantagash]] and a [[Human/Legends|Human]], with Moisk and Bantagash putting their [[Limb/Legends|hands]] on each others backs as they walked through the streets of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]]. Moisk wore a brown [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]] with [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="AOTC" /> Moisk had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and yellowish skin.<ref name="Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fensi Moisk first appeared in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], directed by [[George Lucas]].<ref name="AOTC" /> Moisk was first identified in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars Visual Dictionaries|visual guide]], ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Ultimate Illustrated Guide]]'', which was written by [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="Guide" />
